description: This receipt is issued by Barnes & Noble Booksellers store #2090 located in Victorville, California, and follows a structured retail POS format. The header includes the store name, full address, and phone number, followed by transaction identifiers such as store number, register, transaction number, and cashier name. The receipt contains itemized transaction lines with internal product codes and promotional adjustments, along with a financial summary section displaying subtotal, sales tax, and total amount. Payment details are recorded under a VISA transaction, including masked card number, authorization code, and chip entry method, as well as additional EMV data fields such as AID, TVR, and TSI. A detailed return policy section outlines refund conditions and timelines, followed by a timestamp, transaction code, and a barcode at the bottom. The receipt concludes with a “CUSTOMER COPY” label, reflecting standard bookstore retail receipt formatting and documentation practices.
